consequence.statement: The Argo CD UI now displays an error message when attempting to view logs from a number of pods exceeding an internal limit, providing feedback to users about this constraint.

assertion.statement: The Argo CD UI now shows an error message when the maximum number of pods to view logs is reached.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence describes a UI fix but does not specify a typed subject (API field, configuration key, component flag, etc.); the subject is only described as a UI behavior change without concrete identity; applicability: The evidence does not specify the conditions under which this error message appears (e.g., which user roles, which log viewing scenarios, or configuration state triggers this error message)
